sources.snippet: LiteGPT-Base This is a 124M parameter Language Model (GPT-2 Small architecture) pre-trained from scratch on the FineWeb-Edu dataset. It is the base model for LiteGPT-Instruct. Model Details Architecture: GPT-2 Small (12 layers, 12 heads, 768 embedding dim) Parameters: ~124 Million Context Length: 1024 tokens Training Data: 10 Billion tokens from FineWeb-Edu (Sample 10BT).
